description: This file contains extension methods for internal use, providing syntax sugar for mathematical and time span operations within the Orleans.Streaming.AdoNet namespace.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for double and TimeSpan types to simplify ceiling operations.

methods.name: Int32Ceiling
methods.description: Converts a double to an int by rounding up to the nearest integer using Math.Ceiling.

methods.name: TotalSecondsCeiling
methods.description: Rounds up a TimeSpan's total seconds to the nearest upper second and returns as an integer.

methods.name: SecondsCeiling
methods.description: Returns a TimeSpan representing the ceiling of the total seconds of the input TimeSpan.
